exposure: need for high-frequency oscillatory ventilation during the first 24 hours of life
cohort: The cohort consisted of 67 newborns diagnosed with congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) and treated at the Kepler University Hospital Linz.
finding: "Liver up" status and the need for high-frequency oscillatory ventilation within the first 24 hours of life were identified as significant predictors of hospital mortality in newborns with CDH.
followup_time: Up to hospital discharge or death during initial hospitalization
